extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / potential article creators (especially new users)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for contributors on creating a new Wikipedia article: account requirements, searching for existing pages, troubleshooting visibility/delayed updates, and checking deletion logs or sister projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for 'Stand-up comedy in China' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for alternative capitalizations and different spellings which may already host the content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages linking to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the wiki's link-finding tools to discover if content exists under a different title or is referenced elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent creation may be temporarily invisible; try purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you suspect a database-update delay, wait briefly and/or use the purge function to refresh the page listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and, when appropriate, create redirects from alternate capitalizations to the correct page title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if page was removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review deletion log entries to understand deletion reasons and guidance on how to address issues before recreating content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check sister projects for related content
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for 'Stand-up comedy in China' on one of Wikipedia's sister projects: Wiktionary (dictionary), Wikibooks (textbooks), Wikiquote (quotations), Wikisource (library), Wikiversity (learning resources), Commons (media), Wikivoyage (travel guide), Wikinews (news source), Wikidata (linked database), Wikispecies (species directory).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new article, verify whether related material already exists on sister projects which might be a better fit for the content.
